name: 12203 · Albany, NY
findings: ZIP 12203 (Albany) has 202 nonprofit organizations. 119 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12203 (Albany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12203 (Albany) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
